title: DISCUSSION ONLY
text:
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
DISCUSSION ONLY
Discussion with the Chief Legislative Analyst, City Administrative Officer, and City Attorney regarding updates on the City of Los Angeles’ application to be the Homelessness Management Information System (HMIS) and Coordinated Entry System (CES) lead and the application review process.
summary: Council discussion with the CLA, CAO and City Attorney on the status of the City's application to lead the homelessness management information and coordinated entry systems, and how that application is being reviewed.
